categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the production and sales of DC cooling fans, including brushless fans, blower fans, EC fans, micro fans, and high IP protection level fans. Its products serve various applications such as gaming, IT, communications, servers, industrial control, home appliances, and automotive cooling. The company is expanding into automotive fans, AI server cooling fans, and diversified cooling solutions for emerging markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced fan design technologies including aerodynamic blade shapes, high dynamic pressure bearings (HDB), and smart control circuits for low noise and energy efficiency. It emphasizes vertical integration with in-house mold making, plastic injection, SMT, wire processing, and assembly lines. Automation and intelligent manufacturing systems are progressively implemented to improve production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major computer graphics card manufacturers and system integrators in the gaming, PC, notebook, server, telecom, and automotive sectors. The company serves global markets with a strong focus on the gaming and AI server industries, as well as emerging fields like electric vehicles, smart home appliances, and 5G/AIOT applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Greater China, with manufacturing bases in Dongguan and Jiangxi, China, and sales offices in Taiwan. Its products are sold predominantly in China (over 85% of sales), Taiwan, and other international markets. The company also has subsidiaries registered in the Cayman Islands, Samoa, and the British Virgin Islands for global operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing cooling fans and related components. It maintains vertical integration by producing key parts such as molds, plastic components, and motor windings, and collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of raw materials and downstream customers for system integration.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding into AI, 5G, AIOT, server, automotive electronics, and green energy cooling markets. The company invests heavily in R&D, increasing patent filings annually, and focuses on developing high-performance, energy-efficient, and customized cooling solutions. It also emphasizes automation, smart manufacturing, and sustainability initiatives aligned with ESG principles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of cooling fans and related components. The company serves large volume orders from major OEMs and ODMs in the electronics and automotive industries. It does not rely on subscription or licensing but focuses on manufacturing and selling physical products.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international Japanese firms such as Sanyo Denki, Nidec, and NMB, as well as leading domestic Taiwanese companies like Sunon, Chaun Choung, and Delta Electronics. The company positions itself as a key global supplier in the gaming cooling fan niche with strong R&D capabilities and vertical integration to compete on quality, customization, and delivery speed.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$1.26 billion, a slight decline of 8.64% from the previous year, with a net profit margin around 9.37%. R&D expenditure increased to about NT$88 million, representing nearly 7% of revenue. The workforce grew to over 1,000 employees by early 2025, reflecting ongoing expansion and investment in innovation and production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, long-life, and high-efficiency cooling fans tailored to customer specifications. Its competitive advantages include rapid product design and development cycles, vertical integration for cost control, strong patent portfolio, and ability to provide diverse cooling solutions for emerging high-growth sectors like AI servers and automotive electronics. Commitment to ESG and sustainability further differentiates its brand.
